show.sharing_text_v2:
हेलो! मैंने Kuku FM (Android)  पर यह शो सुना और मुझे यकीन है कि आपको भी यह जरूर पसंद आएगा। 
https://links.kukufm.com/fr2Qgw
show.description: Once a legendary sage who sought immortality, a man is reborn as a poor gambler trapped in debt and humiliation. In his new life, he finds himself married to a mute woman. As his dormant powers begin to awaken, he chooses a different path to protect her, heal her, and redeem a broken life, even if it means sacrificing his godhood.
